question.:question/worked-solution:
First, we express $f$ as the composite function

$$
f=u^3,\,u=\sin v,\,v=26x.
$$

Differentiating gives

$$
\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}=3u^2,\,\frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}v}=\cos v,\,\frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x}=26.
$$

Applying now the chain rule twice, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}x} \\ & =\frac{\text{d}f}{\text{d}u}\cdot \frac{\text{d}u}{\text{d}v}\cdot \frac{\text{d}v}{\text{d}x} \\ & =3u^2\cdot (\cos v)\cdot 26 \\ & =3(\sin(26x))^2\cdot (\cos(26x))\cdot 26 \\ & =78\sin^{2} 26x\cos 26x.\end{aligned}
$$
